messages:
ben_sales: kicking off ApolloEdge POC scoping — they want a short POC to validate three things: 1) support ticket summarization + triage, 2) retrieval-augmented KB answers, 3) similarity-based incident grouping. Need prioritized use cases, endpoints, success criteria, timeline, and a pricing note. can we scope this for a 3-week POC?

mira_se: sounds good. quick clarifying q: is customer expecting hosted API or private/dedicated? that affects infra and SLA asks.

ben_sales: customer prefers Hosted initially, but will push for Dedicated if latency/SLA issues. put both options in the doc. they also want answers for security questionnaire items (SSO, data retention, KMS).

alex_ae: proposed minimal endpoints (start with these 3, can expand):
```
POST /v1/summarize-support  -> input: ticket text, output: summary + triage label
POST /v1/kb-qa             -> input: question + context refs, output: answer + source citations
POST /v1/emb-search        -> input: query, output: top-k doc ids + scores
```
priority order: summarize-support, kb-qa, emb-search. keep responses streaming for long answers.

sam_ml: for model + eval plan:
- model: start with Llama-3-13B (q4) for hosted; offer 70B as fallback for tough cases.
- evals: 100 ticket prompts (customer-provided) + 200 KB QA prompts. metrics: triage accuracy (macro F1), answer correctness (human eval), hallucination rate, embedding cosine > 0.82 for relevant results. latency p95 target: hosted < 350ms for summarize (batched), < 500ms for kb-qa.
- prompt samples: "Summarize the ticket in 2 sentences and assign triage label: bug/feature/support/other."

tara_eng: infra notes (hosted vs dedicated):
- hosted: use shared runtime + prefix caching, no VPC peering; we can reserve a dedicated pool for them to get predictable latency.
- dedicated/private: VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, audit log export to their S3.
- blockers: SSO (SAML) + IP allowlist + contract for data retention + legal review for logs.

jordan_pm: suggested POC timeline (3 weeks):
- week 0 (kick): environment + security checklist signed, sample datasets delivered by customer
- week 1: endpoint scaffold + initial model + smoke tests (summarize-support first)
- week 2: run eval harness (100 tickets) + iterate prompts, add kb-qa
- week 3: customer validation session, SLA/cost estimate, rollout plan + go/no-go decision
acceptance criteria (go):
- triage F1 >= 0.75 on their eval set OR improvement > 20% vs baseline
- kb-qa human correctness >= 80% on sampled Qs
- latency p95 within target or documented mitigation plan

sec-bot: SECURITY CHECKLIST (high level):
- SSO: SAML/OIDC required?
- Data at rest: AES-256 + customer KMS option
- Data in transit: TLS1.2+ enforced
- Retention: default 30d, configurable; need signed retention policy
- Audit logs: support export to their SIEM (CloudWatch/S3)
- Compliance: provide SOC2 artifacts, encryption attestations
- Open items: IL4 classification? (customer indicated regulated devices)

ben_sales: pricing question: they asked for an estimated monthly cost for a 3-week POC (low volume). can we give a rough figure for hosted with a small reserved pool + eval runs? also want to know trial credits or discounts.

alex_ae: rough hosted estimate for POC (ballpark):
- infra + reserved pool + model inference: ~$2k-$4k for the 3-week window depending on qps and model size.
- eval compute (one-time): ~$500 for heavy eval runs.
- we can offer $2k account credit for POC if they sign NDA + SOC2 review within the POC window.
note: dedicated would be higher; we should give them a committed monthly rate estimate if they want a dedicated pool.

mira_se: pending asks for customer before we kick:
- sample 100 support tickets + taxonomy for triage labels
- 200 KB Q/A pairs or their KB dump (pdfs/docs)
- desired SLAs and whether PII is present (if yes, mark for extra review)
- SAML metadata + contact for infra team (for VPC peering if needed)

sam_ml: quick eval harness snippet (we can run internal):
```json
{
  "eval_set": "customer_tickets_100.json",
  "metrics": ["triage_macro_f1","human_correctness","hallucination_rate","latency_p95"]
}
```
run results to be shared as a simple report and sample failures for prompt tuning.

tara_eng: blockers we need from legal/infra: signed DPA, IP allowlist window, KMS access or BYOK agreement. Otherwise we can do a minimally viable hosted POC without VPC.

jordan_pm: owners & next steps:
- ben_sales: confirm customer will deliver datasets and SAML metadata by EOD Thu (owner: ben_sales)
- mira_se: draft POC runbook + eval prompts by Mon (owner: mira_se)
- sam_ml: prepare eval harness + baseline by Tue (owner: sam_ml)
- tara_eng: prepare hosted reserved pool config + security checklist (owner: tara_eng)
- alex_ae: write pricing + credits note for customer (owner: alex_ae)
- sec-bot: send formal security questionnaire link to customer (owner: sec-bot)

ben_sales: I'll confirm timelines with ApolloEdge and push for SAML metadata. scheduling a 30m sync Fri 10am PT. thanks all — :thumbsup:

mira_se: great, will start the runbook. ping me if they have strong PII requirements.

sam_ml: adding a short prompt set to iterate on after we get the tickets.

tara_eng: I'll queue infra tasks and flag any delays asap.

alex_ae: will send the pricing note + credit offer this afternoon.

sec-bot: security questionnaire link sent to apolloedge@company.com (automated).

ben_sales: closing note: aim to have first smoke-result by end of next week. moving to single-thread followups in here.
